clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 3: a TIP-20 transfer made by a precompile inside a frame that later reverts is undone by the same journal, and no precompile path commits after a revert status.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I fetched crates/precompiles/src/storage/evm.rs at a9d67483. sstore_journal (lines 185-211) writes through state_mut().account(), account.storage() and slot.write(), which is the journaled evm2 path. checkpoint and checkpoint_revert (lines 743-759) call State::checkpoint and State::rollback. call() (lines 677-693) returns NestedCallUnavailable when open_checkpoints is not zero, so a precompile cannot commit a callee inside its own checkpoint and roll back around it. In evm2 35aa3280 evm/mod.rs:1809-1810 rolls back whenever the stop is not a success, and interpreter/mod.rs:55-75 sets Stop 1, Return 2, SelfDestruct 3 and revert codes from 0x10, which matches the rule the item states.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 4: TIP-1060 storage credit accounting inside SSTORE changes neither the stored word nor its journal entry, and settle_storage_credit_refunds writes no TIP-20 balance of the PoolManager.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I fetched crates/evm/src/instructions.rs and crates/evm/src/handler/config.rs at a9d67483. In sstore (instructions.rs:86-139) host().sstore writes the word before sstore_storage_credits runs, and the credit step can only return an error, which halts and rolls back the frame. settle_storage_credit_refunds (config.rs:444-487) runs only on a successful result, reads the StorageCredits precompile's transient slots, writes only STORAGE_CREDITS_ADDRESS slots and records a gas refund. It touches no TIP-20 balance. I also checked the writer note: override_balance and override_nonce exist at evm2 state/account.rs:714-731 and change the snapshot too, and they do not appear in the Tempo evm.rs, instructions.rs, handler/config.rs or lib.rs files I fetched, so they cannot undo a revert in a path the PoolManager reaches through those files. The rest of the Tempo tree was not searched, as the item says.
